jobDescription: The paper mill runs two paper machines around the clock and plans their maintenance around the production schedule. The Maintenance Planning Coordinator builds the weekly maintenance plan from the work order backlog, sequences the shutdown work packages with the machine crews, keeps the spare parts reservations current for planned work, prepares the weekly plan review for the maintenance manager, and documents the plan's open items. Shutdown approval stays with the production manager. Reports to the maintenance manager; works with the machine crews, the stores team and the production manager.
requirements: Builds the weekly maintenance plan from the backlog of open work orders under the mill's planning procedure.
Sequences shutdown work packages with the machine crews, with shutdown approval staying with the production manager.
Keeps spare parts reservations current for planned work with the stores team.
Prepares the weekly plan review for the maintenance manager and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents the plan's open items and hand-over conditions each week.

evidence.text: Maintenance planning coordinator at a paper mill with two paper machines for three years, building each week's maintenance plan from the open work orders under the mill's planning procedure in the maintenance system.
Sequenced the shutdown work packages with the two machine crews for the monthly shutdowns; the shutdown approval was the production manager's, recorded on the shutdown plan.
Kept the spare parts reservations current for planned work with the stores team, with the reservation report reconciled each week.
Prepared the weekly plan review for the maintenance manager, recording in the review which plan changes I made and which came from the crews' feedback.
Wrote the plan's open items list and the hand-over conditions for the next week's planning at each review.

Work sample: one weekly maintenance plan with its work order list, one shutdown plan with the production manager's approval, one reservation report and one weekly plan review, with the maintenance system references as a verification trail.

Reference call with the former maintenance manager: confirmed the candidate built the weekly plans and sequenced the shutdown packages in the period, with shutdown approval staying with production, and confirmed the dates.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate can attend a half-day site visit next week and confirmed the shift pattern is acceptable; no relocation needed.

gold.expectedGap: None; the materials document the planning, the sequencing and approval boundary, the reservations, the reviews and the hand-over notes.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the approval boundary as documented: sequencing by the candidate, shutdown approval by the production manager; the packet makes no judgement.
